content_data.project_title: Entertainment AI: Personalized Content Recommendation Engine
content_data.project_description: A mobile-first AI-driven recommendation system to enhance user engagement and content discovery for a regional entertainment platform.
content_data.timeline: Over 15 months, with an initial MVP launch within 6 months and full feature rollout by month 12.
objectives: Establish a scalable AI infrastructure capable of supporting future feature expansions.
deliverables: A/B testing framework for continuous optimization of recommendation algorithms.
competitive_analysis: Global streaming giants offer advanced AI, but often lack regional content depth and cultural nuances.
content_data.risk_mitigation: Risks include data privacy concerns, algorithm bias, and integration complexities. Mitigation strategies involve robust data anonymization, continuous bias detection and correction, and phased integration with extensive testing.

memory_deletes.removed_item: Full-featured recommendation system with advanced personalization by month 12.
